e7_s4_rationale: The histopathology showing band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis with round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and immunohistochemistry positive for CD34 and CD31, is consistent with epithelioid hemangioma.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Typically has a more prominent spindle cell component and often involves the deeper dermis

e7_s4_rejected.label: angioma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Too broad a term and does not specifically match the histopathological findings

e7_s4_rejected.label: pyogenic granuloma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Usually has a more lobular architecture and prominent inflammatory infiltrate

e7_s4_rejected.label: bacillary angiomatosis
e7_s4_rejected.why: Typically has a more prominent neutrophilic infiltrate and is associated with Bartonella infection
